Nacho Ride

Ann Arbor, MI

Nacho Ride is a road group ride in Ann Arbor, MI. It meets every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, April–October, starting at Homes Brewery. Expect about 43 miles, slow, then fast for the last 15 km, then nachos.

About the Nacho Ride group ride

Out-and-back on one straight road from Homes Brewery. Most of it is chill; the last stretch home gets fast. Ends with nachos. Listed as no-drop style by Wheels in Motion.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
